sentiment: The fragile things last not through strength but through tending — held in the dark, for months and years, by hands that keep showing up.

stories.title: Physicists trap a single antimatter particle for a month
stories.summary: The most fragile thing in the room kept alive for thirty days — not by strength, but by unbroken attention to a field that must never lapse.

stories.title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
stories.summary: Twelve years spent tending one small, stubborn engine — proof that a long devotion to an unglamorous thing is itself a kind of building.

stories.title: How close can pure functional programming get to C?
stories.summary: Closing the distance between a high abstraction and the bare machine — the work of carrying a fragile idea all the way down to metal.
